name: image.contact-sheet
title: Contact sheet
summary: Lay images out in a grid so a set of stills can be reviewed at a glance.
description: Scales each image to a fixed width, pads them to the height of the first image, and lays them out with ffmpeg's xstack. Optional labels are drawn with drawtext when that filter is available. A single image is returned as one cell.

images.description: Images to put on the sheet, in reading order. Workspace paths, job:<id>/<output> or pin:<name>.

columns.description: Number of columns in the grid.

cell_width.description: Width of each cell in pixels; height follows the image's aspect ratio.

labels.description: Caption for each cell: an array with one string per image, or "auto" for the file basenames. Omit for no labels.

background.description: Background colour for the padding and the gaps, as an ffmpeg colour name or 0xRRGGBB value.

format.description: Output image format; writes sheet.png or sheet.jpg.

examples.title: Six stills in a three-column grid
